# Terranova Strategy

Terranova Strategy is a territorial strategy consultancy. It helps businesses and public organisations understand territorial exposure, navigate disruption, build resilience, recover after major disruption, and support long-term territorial development.

The commercial offer is three services. Related fields (climate resilience, territorial risk, physical climate risk, supply chain resilience, operational resilience, infrastructure resilience, business continuity, strategic recovery, reconstruction, territorial development, regional development, sustainability) are areas of expertise connected to those services — not separate products.

## Pages

- [Home](https://terranovastrategy.com/)
- [About](https://terranovastrategy.com/about) — mission, vision, connected fields, and how the three services sit in that work
- [Territorial Exposure Assessment](https://terranovastrategy.com/exposure-assessment) — before disruption: map dependencies, score exposure (TEAM), grade action
- [Crisis Management and Business Continuity](https://terranovastrategy.com/disruption-response) — during the event: reactivation timeframes, government and company tracks, capital this week
- [Strategic Territorial Recovery](https://terranovastrategy.com/territorial-recovery) — after emergency works: reconstruction sequence and element action plan
- [Insights](https://terranovastrategy.com/insights) — research and perspectives on territorial intelligence, risk, resilience and recovery
- [Contact](https://terranovastrategy.com/contact)

The insights index lists every published article. Open that page, then each article below. The article text is in the HTML.

## Insights

- [The hidden territorial dependencies of business continuity](https://terranovastrategy.com/insights/territorial-dependencies-business-continuity) — 9 October 2026. A site can stay intact and still stop when the road, power, water, suppliers or logistics around it fail.
- [How can climate-related events affect supply chain management?](https://terranovastrategy.com/insights/climate-related-events-supply-chain-management) — 21 October 2026. Floods, storms and drought close the warehouses, corridors, suppliers and plants a supply chain runs through.
- [How the 2024 Valencia flood stopped a working region](https://terranovastrategy.com/insights/valencia-flood-2024-territorial-recovery) — 29 October 2026. Industrial parks are running again. The works that would change the next flood are still waiting.
- [How the Colombia earthquake blocked the Pacific corridor](https://terranovastrategy.com/insights/colombia-earthquake-operational-disruption) — 18 September 2026. The earthquake cut the corridors that feed the Coffee Axis and the Pacific port, and the operations inland of them.
- [The lower levels of the Danube and the Rhine have cost €5 billion to Central Europe](https://terranovastrategy.com/insights/danube-rhine-low-water-cost-central-europe) — 18 September 2026. A severe low-water season on the two rivers carries an industrial bill of about €5 billion.
- [What does Permafrost exposure risk mean for alpine regions?](https://terranovastrategy.com/insights/permafrost-exposure-risk-alpine-regions) — 17 September 2026. The question is which valleys, crossings and settlements sit in the path of thawing ground.
- [What does wildfire exposure mean for southern Europe?](https://terranovastrategy.com/insights/wildfire-risk-southern-europe) — 18 September 2026. The 2026 season showed which land, corridors and cities sit inside the fire.
- [The changing geography of global supply chains](https://terranovastrategy.com/insights/geography-of-global-supply-chains) — 3 June 2026. Supply chains run through territories that flood, congest, close and get politicised.
